expectations.text: Explains the logic: the CI for the difference between two statistics is not derived from the overlap of their individual CIs; they are separate quantities
expectations.evidence: "The CI for the difference is what you need, and it has its own (often much narrower) uncertainty." Also gives the variance formula Var(A−B) = Var(A) + Var(B) − 2Cov(A,B) to show the difference has its own distributional quantity.
